_comment: Demo dataset for `occ pipelinq:demo:seed` (DemoSeedService). Every object is marked with the '[Demo]' prefix on its lookup field (client.name / contact.name / pipeline.title / queue.title / product.name / lead.title / ticket.title / task.subject) so the seed is idempotent (exact-match lookup) and removable (--remove deletes exactly this set). Date placeholders: '@days:N' -> Y-m-d today+N, '@datetime:N' -> ISO-8601 today+N. openspec/changes/align-claims-and-first-hour REQ-SETUP-PIP-008.
_coverageNote: The contacts / pipelines / queues / products / complaints / tasks sections were added 2026-08-06. Measured on run 31082256226: the CONTACTS, TASKS and PIPELINES index pages had a genuinely empty collection on a fresh install — the base register ships example objects for products (14), queues (3), clients, leads, tickets and the POS entities, but none at all for contact, task or pipeline — so CnIndexPage rendered `cn-index-page__empty` and no data table, silently, with no console error and no failed request. Every 'the list table renders' assertion in tests/e2e/spec-coverage failed for a reason that pointed at the page rather than at the fixture. Queues and Products were NOT empty; the extra rows here exist so the seeded set is coherent (a client has contact persons, a queue has a complaint routed to it) rather than to repair those two pages.
